sonnet.problem: Card 18 goes back to verse 17 after card 16 told verse 17 and card 17 asked about verse 18, so the cards are out of passage order. It also repeats that God heals them, which card 16 already said. It moves nothing forward and works as a recap.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead. / No recap cards. / Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

sonnet.problem: The question names Sarah ("Abimelech says Abraham told him Sarah was his sister"), and the right answer is "Sarah herself". The other two answers are groups of people, so Sarah is the obvious pick and the question gives the answer away.
sonnet.rule: A choice card's question never holds its own answer, or a form of it, like "rock badgers" for "in the rocks." Ask something else.
